name: sweep_ground
text: A person sweeps the floor with a long broom. The right hand holds the upper handle close to chest height, and the left hand holds the lower handle beside the left hip. Both elbows point down. Keep the bristles on the ground while making short sideways strokes beside the left foot, feet planted.
